requirement: All SQL queries must use parameterized queries, prepared statements, or an approved ORM/query builder.
prohibited: String concatenation or f-string/template interpolation when constructing SQL from user-controlled input.
bad_example: query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = {user_id}"
remediation: Rewrite the query using parameter binding instead of string interpolation.

requirement: All user-controlled database parameters must be bound, never embedded directly into the SQL string.
prohibited: Passing raw, unbound user input into any part of a SQL statement.
bad_example: cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user=" + user_input)
remediation: Bind all user-controlled values as query parameters.

requirement: Use approved ORM/query-builder APIs for database access rather than hand-written raw SQL where practical.
prohibited: Ad-hoc raw SQL string building outside the approved ORM/query-builder layer.
bad_example: db.raw(f"UPDATE accounts SET balance={amount} WHERE id={acct_id}")
remediation: Migrate raw SQL call sites to the approved ORM/query-builder.

requirement: Validate and constrain user input server-side (type, length, format/allow-list) before it reaches a query.
prohibited: Trusting client-supplied input without server-side validation.
remediation: Add explicit server-side validation/type-coercion before the value is used.

requirement: Database credentials must never be hardcoded in source code.
prohibited: Literal usernames/passwords/connection strings committed to the repository.
remediation: Move credentials to environment variables or a secrets manager; rotate any exposed credential.
